description: Build the People Directory (/people), individual student profile page (/people/[id]), and Connections page (/connections). These are independent of the messaging feature (FEAT-004) but the ConnectButton on /people/[id] uses useConnections hook (already implemented in hooks/useConnections.ts). The /people/[id] page also shows a 'Message' button that calls startConversation from hooks/useMessages.ts (already implemented).
steps: 1. Create app/people/page.tsx — 'use client'. People directory. Uses supabase from createClient() to query profiles. On mount: fetch `supabase.from('profiles').select('id, name, usn, year, branch, section, bio, avatar_url, skills, interests, role, faculty_status, designation').order('name').limit(100)`. Local state: `searchQuery` (string), `branchFilter` (always 'CSE'), `yearFilter` (0|1|2|3|4), `roleFilter` ('all'|'student'|'faculty'). Filter client-side from fetched array: match name/usn/skills/designation against searchQuery (case-insensitive), filter by year and role. Render a search input, year filter chips, role tabs ('ALL', 'STUDENTS', 'FACULTY'). Render a grid of ProfileCard components from components/ProfileCard.tsx (already exists). Show a loading state (use LoadingSkeleton from components/LoadingSkeleton.tsx) and empty state (use EmptyState from components/EmptyState.tsx). Wrap entire page content in a standard layout: include Navbar at top. Use pixel-retro inline styles consistent with the rest of the app. The page does NOT need the full CommunityProvider sidebar layout — use a simpler 2-column layout (search/filter sidebar + grid). NO 'use client' on layout-level; this file is 'use client' because it uses hooks.

2. Create app/people/[id]/page.tsx — 'use client'. Individual profile page. Uses `useParams` from 'next/navigation' to get `id`. Fetches `supabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', id).single()` on mount. Fetches connection count: `supabase.from('connection_requests').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).or(`requester_id.eq.${id},addressee_id.eq.${id}`).eq('status', 'accepted')`. Renders: Avatar (UserAvatar), name, USN badge, role badge, year/branch, designation (for faculty), bio, skills chips, interests chips, connection count, expertise array (for faculty). Shows ConnectButton from components/ConnectButton.tsx for connect/pending/connected state. Shows 'Message' button (calls startConversation(id) from hooks/useMessages.ts, then router.push to `/messages?conv=${convId}`) ONLY when action==='connected'. Shows 'Verified Faculty' badge when isVerifiedFaculty(profile). Shows their recent posts: fetch `supabase.from('posts').select('id, title, type, created_at, tags').eq('author_id', id).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(5)` and render as a simple list of clickable titles that scroll to the feed with a search. Include Navbar at top. Loading skeleton while fetching.

3. Create app/connections/page.tsx — 'use client'. This page is in the middleware PROTECTED_PREFIXES so unauthenticated users are redirected to /signin. Uses useConnections() hook from hooks/useConnections.ts which already provides `incoming`, `outgoing`, `connected`, `respond`, `refresh`. Three tabs: 'CONNECTIONS' (accepted), 'PENDING' (incoming + outgoing combined), 'FIND PEOPLE' (links to /people). Connections tab: list connected users as ProfileCard-like rows (show avatar, name, usn, year, branch, a 'Message' button that calls startConversation then routes to /messages?conv=X, and a 'Remove' button that calls respond(id, 'cancelled')). Wait — 'cancelled' is for outgoing requests. For removing an accepted connection, the correct approach is to update status to 'cancelled' (there is no 'removed' status in the schema; 'cancelled' is used for this). Actually re-read the schema: connection_requests has status in ('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'cancelled'). To remove a connection, update status to 'cancelled'. The respond() function in useConnections accepts ('accepted'|'rejected'|'cancelled'). Pending tab: show incoming requests with Accept/Decline buttons (respond(id, 'accepted'/'rejected')), and outgoing requests with a 'Cancel' button (respond(id, 'cancelled')). Include Navbar at top.

4. Update SidebarLeft.tsx to add connection count and links to /connections and /messages when currentUser is logged in. Add `useConnections` hook call inside SidebarLeft... BUT SidebarLeft is already a client component that uses useCommunity(). Adding useConnections() would trigger an additional Supabase query on every page load. Better approach: show static links without count, or pass connection count as a prop. Decision: add two Link buttons in SidebarLeft below EDIT PROFILE: 'CONNECTIONS' linking to /connections and 'MESSAGES' linking to /messages, using the existing button style. Keep it simple — no count fetch in sidebar to avoid extra queries.
5. Run `npm run build` to confirm no TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: GET /people renders a searchable, filterable grid of student and faculty profiles using ProfileCard
GET /people/[id] renders a full profile page with connection status button and post history
GET /connections (authenticated) shows three tabs: connections, pending requests, find people link
Accept/Decline/Cancel connection actions work via useConnections hook
SidebarLeft has CONNECTIONS and MESSAGES links
